title: Singular and Plural Nouns in Biology
objective: Students control plural forms, countable nouns, and common scientific irregular plurals.
outcomes: Use singular and plural nouns correctly.
Distinguish countable and uncountable biology nouns.
Use several, many, each, and every accurately.
activity: Plural lab: students match singular/plural pairs and use them in biology sentences.
example: “Bacteria were observed” is plural; “A bacterium was observed” is singular.
